_comment: THE BADGE CATALOG. Hand-edited. scripts/build_api.py turns this plus
certified.json into the public badge endpoints and the Wall of Fame.
Adding a badge is an entry here. Never reuse or repurpose an id — someone's
README may already render it, and a badge that silently changes meaning is
worse than no badge. Retire instead: set retired: true (holders keep it).
points drive the Wall of Fame ordering and nothing else. Keep them
proportional to real effort, not to enthusiasm.

badges.name: RAPP Ready
badges.summary: Completed the guided walkthrough and passed the knowledge check.
badges.criteria: Finish the RAPP walkthrough end to end, then score 80% or better on the RAPP Ready check.
badges.how: Take the check at api.html#quiz, then open the pre-filled claim it generates.

badges.name: Agent Published
badges.summary: Shipped an agent to the library that passed review.
badges.criteria: At least one merged agent under agents/@<username>/ with a valid manifest, no secrets, and a stated business use case.
badges.how: Follow docs/PUBLISHING.md. Awarded automatically on merge.

badges.name: Brainstem Operator
badges.summary: Ran the brainstem end to end and installed an agent from the library.
badges.criteria: Install the brainstem (any tier), install a library agent, and show it answering.
badges.how: Open a claim with the transcript or a screenshot of the agent responding.

badges.name: Skill Converter
badges.summary: Converted an outside skill into a RAPP-compliant agent or skill.
badges.criteria: A merged conversion that carries upstream attribution, a compatible license, and passes the quality gates.
badges.how: Follow docs/AGGREGATION.md, then submit as a normal publisher pull request.

badges.name: Reviewer
badges.criteria: Sustained, substantive review of other people's pull requests, at a maintainer's invitation.
